method: Each mutant replaces one fragment (asserted to occur exactly once) in its file, runs the 7 test files above under vitest with the JSON reporter, and restores every source in finally. A mutant is killed when the run exits non-zero (failedTests lists each failing test) or is stopped after 120 s (killedBy "timeout": a reader that blocks on a FIFO cannot be interrupted by vitest's own test timeout). The unmutated baseline runs first and must pass.
